features.title: AXI4-Lite subordinate IP
features.description: Parameterized AXI4-Lite subordinate module for CSR access. Generates read/write decode logic, byte enables, and response signaling from a register map definition. Foundation for SoC peripheral integration.

features.title: CSR / register map generator
features.description: Define register maps in Python (name, offset, fields, access type). Generates: RTL register file, C header, Python test driver, markdown docs. Uses AXI4-Lite subordinate as the bus interface.

features.title: Black-box module instantiation
features.description: First-class BlackBox declaration with ports only (no body). Emits clean Verilog instantiation for vendor IP (Xilinx BRAM, PLLs, ASIC memory compilers). Supports constraint propagation and parameter forwarding.

features.title: Verilator co-simulation backend
features.description: Compile emitted Verilog with Verilator, drive from Python via ctypes/pybind. Same VeripyTestCase API, 100-1000x faster than Python sim. Enables system-level testing of large designs.

features.title: SymbiYosys formal verification integration
features.description: Emit .sby files from assert_always/cover properties. Run bounded model checking via SymbiYosys. Report counterexamples as VCD traces. Support assume/restrict for compositional proofs.

features.title: Memory inference annotations
features.description: Mem() style hints: style='block'|'distributed'|'ultra'. Emit (* ram_style *) attributes. Support dual-port and true dual-port variants with correct Verilog coding patterns for Vivado/Quartus/DC.

features.title: Parameterized IP building blocks
features.description: Sync FIFO, round-robin arbiter, priority arbiter, credit-based flow control, clock divider, edge detector, debouncer. All with dual-path tests and synthesizable Verilog output.

features.title: Build system and vendor tool integration
features.description: Dependency-ordered file lists for Vivado/Quartus/DC. Tcl script generation. Incremental rebuild (only re-emit changed modules). Project concept tracking all modules and relationships.

features.title: Auto-documentation generation
features.description: Generate markdown/HTML from module definitions: port tables, parameter descriptions, register maps, block diagrams (mermaid). Leverage Python introspection.

features.title: Formal equivalence checking
features.description: Prove Python behavioral model matches emitted Verilog via Yosys equiv_check. CLI command: veripy equiv <file.py>. Stronger guarantee than dual-path simulation.

features.title: Advanced lint checks
features.description: Combinational loop detection, latch inference warnings, clock domain annotation with automatic CDC violation flagging for raw signal crossings between annotated domains.

features.title: Pip-installable IP packages
features.description: Publish VeriPy IP as pip packages (e.g. pip install veripy-axi). Version-pinned, tested, reusable. Package discovery and dependency resolution for hardware IP.

features.title: Enhanced testing model: reactive yields, fork/join, constrained random, transaction helpers, coverage reporting
features.description: Reactive yields (until), fork/join concurrency, constrained random integration, Driver base class for protocol helpers, coverage reporting with hit counts.
